name: Welcome Modal
description: Startup workspace picker modal. Shows 'COCKPIT IDE' branding, recent workspaces list (with remove buttons), and 'Open Workspace' button (triggers native directory picker via IPC). 'Close' button resolves with null (closes window). Each recent workspace path is validated for existence; missing paths are highlighted. Returns Promise<string | null>. Escape key dismisses.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show modal overlay, load recent workspaces, resolve with selected path or null

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Promise resolution (overlay hidden, element stays in DOM)
